HTML Forms, Properly

Two short modules on labelling form fields and letting the browser validate them.

After this course you can…

  • Connect every control to a visible label
  • Use built-in constraint validation instead of hand-written checks

Modules

  1. Labels that work — 10 min
  2. Built-in validation — 12 min
